title: What's New: Enhanced Inventory Analytics (2026 release wave 1)

features.name: ABC Analysis in Power BI
features.description: New Power BI app for inventory with ABC analysis capability allowing users to slice and dice based on ABC classes to categorize inventory items as A, B, or C based on sales percentage thresholds.

features.name: ABC Analysis Excel Layout
features.description: New Excel layout for ABC analysis report with printable worksheet and analysis worksheet designed for slice and dice with slices on ABC class type and inventory posting groups.
caveats: Originally only in German and Swiss versions, now delocalised to all regions

features.name: ABC Analysis Setup Page
features.description: New page in the application where users define ABC threshold percentages that must sum to 100 percent, used for both Power BI and Excel reports.

features.name: Item Age Composition Report
features.description: New report showing item age composition by both quantity and value in a single report, replacing legacy reports that showed either quantity or value separately.

features.name: Excel and Word Layout Modernization
features.description: Eight reports updated with Excel and Word layouts to replace legacy IDE layouts, allowing users to change layouts using Word add-in or Excel analysis.
caveats: Eight reports updated; four legacy reports will be deprecated

features.name: Legacy Inventory Report Deprecation
features.description: Four legacy inventory reports are being deprecated and will be removed from the product over the next three release waves.
caveats: Four reports to be removed over three release waves

features.name: Inventory Report Subtotals
features.description: Subtotals functionality being added to all new inventory reports in version 28.x to make analysis easier in the analysis worksheet.
caveats: Version 28.0 does not have subtotals; subtotals coming in 28.x

features.name: Analysis Views for Item Ledger Entries
features.description: New ability to supply analysis views with application in AL, with four pre-built analysis views for item ledger entries that users can customize or hide.
caveats: Four pre-built analysis views provided that can be hidden via personal customization

features.name: Inventory Analytics Help and Discoverability
features.description: Legacy inventory reports are now discoverable in advanced tell me, help pane, copilot chat, and Microsoft Learn documentation for better visibility.
